description: The file defines the Configurator class which manages application configuration in SuiteCRM, including loading, saving, overriding configurations, handling logger settings, and some utility functions related to site branding and email confirmation settings.

classes.name: Configurator
classes.description: A class responsible for managing SuiteCRM configuration settings, including loading existing configs, updating settings via POST data, handling config overrides, logging configuration, and utility functions related to logos and email templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes configuration by loading existing settings.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the current configuration from the global $sugar_config variable and assigns a logger.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Updates configuration settings based on POST data, with validation for logger file extensions and names.

methods.name: checkLoggerFileName
methods.description: Validates logger filename and extension, setting defaults if invalid.

methods.name: trimValue
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a filename.

methods.name: prependDot
methods.description: Ensures a string begins with a dot, used for file extension handling.

methods.name: hasValidExtension
methods.description: Checks whether a given filename extension is valid, not in the list of bad extensions.

methods.name: handleOverride
methods.description: Creates or updates the override configuration file based on current config differences, merging in previous overrides and handling specific config dependencies.

methods.name: addKeyToIgnoreOverride
methods.description: Adds a key to the list of override keys to ignore during override handling.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears caches if specific configuration changes occur, particularly for 'stack_trace_errors'.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves configuration by processing images, updating config from POST, handling overrides, and clearing caches.

methods.name: readOverride
methods.description: Reads the override configuration from 'config_override.php' if exists.

methods.name: saveOverride
methods.description: Writes the override configuration PHP code to 'config_override.php'.

methods.name: overrideClearDuplicates
methods.description: Removes previous override entries for a specific array and key from the override string.

methods.name: replaceOverride
methods.description: Replaces or adds a specific key-value override in the override string.

methods.name: restoreConfig
methods.description: Restores configuration to defaults and redirects to the Configurator page.

methods.name: saveImages
methods.description: Saves uploaded logos, calling saveCompanyLogo if a logo is provided.

methods.name: checkTempImage
methods.description: Verifies an uploaded image file is valid.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message related to image validation.

methods.name: saveCompanyLogo
methods.description: Saves the company logo to the custom theme directory.

methods.name: parseLoggerSettings
methods.description: Reads and parses logger configuration from 'log4php.properties', or sets defaults if absent, and handles logger-related configuration.

methods.name: isConfirmOptInEnabled
methods.description: Checks if email confirm opt-in is enabled.

methods.name: isOptInEnabled
methods.description: Checks if email opt-in is enabled.

methods.name: getConfirmOptInTemplateId
methods.description: Retrieves the email template ID for confirm opt-in.

methods.name: getConfirmOptInEnumValue
methods.description: Returns the enum value for email confirm opt-in status.
